mapper.sql: select id, call_id, parent_call_id, run_id, user_id, operation_key, tool_name, tool_category, budget_group, status, result_code, retryable, confirmation_required, arguments_summary, result_summary, result_token_estimate, duration_ms, started_at, completed_at, confirmation_expires_at from ai_tool_call_trace
mapper.insert: insert into ai_tool_call_trace (call_id, parent_call_id, run_id, user_id, operation_key, tool_name, tool_category, budget_group, status, result_code, retryable, confirmation_required, arguments_summary, result_summary, result_token_estimate, duration_ms, started_at, completed_at, confirmation_expires_at) values (#{callId}, #{parentCallId}, #{runId}, #{userId}, #{operationKey}, #{toolName}, #{toolCategory}, #{budgetGroup}, #{status}, #{resultCode}, #{retryable}, #{confirmationRequired}, #{argumentsSummary}, #{resultSummary}, #{resultTokenEstimate}, #{durationMs}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{confirmationExpiresAt})
mapper.update: update ai_tool_call_trace set status = #{status}, result_code = #{resultCode}, retryable = #{retryable}, result_summary = #{resultSummary}, result_token_estimate = #{resultTokenEstimate}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, confirmation_expires_at = #{confirmationExpiresAt}, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'WAITING_CONFIRMATION' THEN NULL ELSE NOW(3) END where call_id = #{callId}
update ai_tool_call_trace set status = #{status}, completed_at = NOW(3) where call_id = #{callId}
mapper.select: order by started_at desc limit LEAST(#{limit}, 100)
